[LNAM.1.1] DS identifiers are drawn from full Unicode. Three coupled surfaces move
together: **(a)** identifiers over Unicode (this doc); **(b)** classification of an
identifier as a *type reference* or a *binding* by grammatical **position** rather
than by case ([LGRA]); **(c)** the postfix conversion operator `::`
([LCST]). (b) is a precondition of (a) for caseless scripts.
